question: The marked price of a smartwatch set is ₹640. It sells with two successive discounts of 30% and 25%. An additional 25% discount is given on cash payment. What is the selling price (in ₹) of the smartwatch set on cash payment?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹640

First Discount = 30%

Second Discount = 25%

Additional Cash Discount = 25%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP times (1 - frac{{Discount}₁}{100}) times (1 - frac{{Discount}₂}{100}) times (1 - frac{{Discount}₃}{100})

**Calculations:**

SP = 640 times (1 - (30)/(100)) times (1 - (25)/(100)) times (1 - (25)/(100))

SP = 640 times (1 - 0.30) times (1 - 0.25) times (1 - 0.25)

SP = 640 times 0.70 times 0.75 times 0.75

SP = (640 times 0.70) times 0.75 times 0.75

SP = 448 times 0.75 times 0.75

SP = ₹252

**∴ The selling price of the smartwatch set on cash payment is ₹252.**
